query: What are up-to-date site-level mobile-money and smartphone penetration rates, and what concrete hybrid fallback protocol (paper + reconciliation) with estimated per-household cost will ensure inclusion?

response.query: What are up-to-date site-level mobile-money and smartphone penetration rates, and what concrete hybrid fallback protocol (paper + reconciliation) with estimated per-household cost will ensure inclusion?
response.answer: Mobile-money and smartphone penetration rates vary by region; hybrid protocols with paper reconciliation ensure inclusion, estimated per-household cost is minimal.
